broke.question: If I receive a gift worth INR 2,500 from a supplier, what must I do within 5 working days?
broke.verdict: agent regression: lost the fix the critic loop made in iteration 1
broke.new_answer: You must declare the gift to the Compliance Officer within 5 working days. It will either be returned or donated.

broke.question: If a grievance isn't solved by the reporting manager, how many working days does the Head of Department have to reply after the grievance is written up?
broke.verdict: agent regression: lost the fix the critic loop made in iteration 1
broke.new_answer: The Head of Department must respond within 7 working days.

document_changes.old: Leave Policy: Shore Staff Meridian Shipmanagement Pvt Ltd | Document HR-POL-03 | Edition 2026 1.
document_changes.new: Leave Policy: Shore Staff Meridian Shipmanagement Pvt Ltd | Document HR-POL-03 | Edition 2027 1.

document_changes.old: Annual Leave Every confirmed employee is entitled to 21 days of annual leave per leave year.
document_changes.new: Annual Leave Every confirmed employee is entitled to 24 days of annual leave per leave year.

document_changes.old: Annual leave accrues at 1.75 days for each completed month of service.
document_changes.new: Annual leave accrues at 2 days for each completed month of service.

document_changes.old: Carry Forward and Encashment Unused annual leave of up to 10 days may be carried forward into the next leave year.
document_changes.new: Carry Forward and Encashment Unused annual leave of up to 15 days may be carried forward into the next leave year.

document_changes.old: Any balance above 10 days lapses on 31 December.
document_changes.new: Any balance above 15 days lapses on 31 December.

document_changes.old: Paternity Leave Male employees are entitled to 5 working days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth or adoption of a child.
document_changes.new: Paternity Leave Male employees are entitled to 10 working days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth or adoption of a child.
